propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking way to verify mapped-key and legacy_default visibility to the bot outside a full reconcile pass
The bridge fsck command must add an opt-in --live-visibility flag that performs a read-only, advisory live visibility check without mutating bridge state or altering the exit code
The visibility check must gracefully degrade when Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are absent, emitting a skipped advisory verdict rather than failing
The shared visibility helper (check_mapped_project_visibility from access_check.py) must be reused to avoid duplicate existence-check logic
The advisory output must be written to stderr in both text and JSON modes, leaving the stdout JSON schema unchanged and requiring no schema contract test modifications
Core rebar doctor must remain Jira-free with no new reconciler or agents imports reachable from _commands/doctor.py
